title: Qwen3.6-27B sole-T16 dense Q4 integer-MMQ screen

candidate.description: Source-shaped dense Q4T16 x K-major Q8_1 integer WMMA. The candidate decoded only the existing resident Q4T16 bytes, used a bounded transient DS4 activation workspace, applied Q4 scale/min and Q8 scale/sum corrections after integer WMMA, and never changed runtime dispatch or persistent residency.
candidate.source_lineage: llama.cpp HIP 1ebf790cda38 ggml-cuda mmq.cuh/mma.cuh/quantize.cu, adapted through hipEngine's existing Q5 I128/J128/K256 scaffold

measurements.protocol: balanced HIP-event leaf timing, three warmups, nine samples, actual immutable Qwen3.6-27B weight

resource_diagnosis.interpretation: HIP 7.2 catastrophically spilled the branch-free specialization. Using the bounded body removed spills and improved the candidate 25.9%, but the spill-free integer consumer remained about 2.1x slower than the retained FP16-WMMA owner. Activation packing was only about 0.013-0.032 ms and was not the blocker. A smaller I64/J64 tile also lost.

commands.guard: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest -q tests/test_gguf_q4_t16_dense_mmq.py
commands.benchmark: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 PYTHONPATH=. uv run python scripts/gguf_q4_t16_dense_mmq_bench.py --rows 512 --in-features 5120 --out-features 6144 --warmups 3 --samples 9 --json /tmp/q4-t16-dense-mmq.json

decision: Reject and remove the kernel, wrapper, tests, and benchmark harness. No runtime/default, decode, MTP, or residency path changed. Do not repeat source-shaped I128/J128 or smaller I64/J64 T16 integer MMQ without a materially different weight-consumer dataflow or compiler/source change.
